name: Sant Mori (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red chevron couched pointing to the fly and a blue heraldic rock at the hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Sant Mori; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron couched from the hoist pointing to the fly
heraldic rock (chess rook) at the hoist
